chunks: Verily, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, created a Name with letters without sound, with words without speech, with a personality without a body, with resemblance without attributes, and with color without coloring. Dimensions are negated from Him, limits are remote from Him, the perception of every imaginer is veiled from Him — He is self-concealing without being covered.

So He made it a complete word upon four parts together, none of which precedes another. He manifested three Names from it for the need of creation toward them, and He veiled one of them — and it is the Hidden, Treasured Name. These are the Names that manifested; the Manifest one is Allah, Blessed and Exalted. And He, Glorified be He, subjected four pillars to every Name of these Names, making twelve pillars in all.

Then He created for every pillar from these thirty Names, a deed attributed to them. So He is: the All-Beneficent, the All-Merciful, the King, the Holy, the Creator, the Maker, the Fashioner, the Living, the Self-Subsisting — neither slumber nor sleep seizes Him — the All-Knowing, the All-Aware, the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing, the Wise, the Almighty, the Compeller, the Supremely Great, the Most High, the Magnificent, the All-Powerful, the Able, the Source of Peace, the Bestower of Security, the Guardian, the Originator, the Builder, the Unprecedented Creator, the Lofty, the Majestic, the Generous, the Sustainer, the Life-Giver, the Death-Causer, the Resurrector, the Inheritor.

These are the Names, and whatever was from the Most Beautiful Names until three hundred and sixty Names are complete — they are a relation to these three Names. These three Names are pillars, and He veiled the single Hidden, Treasured Name by these three Names.
And that is His saying, the Exalted: 'Say: Call upon Allah or call upon the All-Beneficent; whichever you call upon, to Him belong the Most Beautiful Names.'

key_terms.الأركان: Pillars/elements — structural components of the Divine Name hierarchy
key_terms.الأسماء الحسنى: The Most Beautiful Names of God (al-Asma' al-Husna)
key_terms.الاسم المكنون: The Hidden/Concealed Name — a transcendent Divine Name beyond all manifestation
key_terms.تبارك وتعالى: Blessed and Exalted — a formula of glorification for God

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the creation of the Divine Names in al-Kafi?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) expounds a profound metaphysical doctrine about the Divine Names. God created a primordial, transcendent Name that transcends all physical and conceptual categories — it has no sound, speech, body, resemblance, or color — and this Name is self-concealing rather than merely hidden. This primordial Name was made into a complete word of four parts, from which three Names were revealed for creation's benefit (the Manifest Name being 'Allah'), while one remained hidden and treasured. The three revealed Names each contain four pillars, yielding twelve total, each pillar generating thirty active Names — accounting for the 360 Divine Names. The teaching concludes by citing Quran 17:110, which affirms that all beautiful Names belong to God alone.
